outlet: Walla Walla Union-Bulletin, "Columbia County commissioners decline to join Franklin County's non-sanctuary status" (Erick Bengel, 2025-08-12)
notes: August 4, 2025 board meeting: the three Republican commissioners (Hall, Rundell, Miller) declined Franklin County's invitation; Miller: "Dollars and cents" and "I'd say just 'no comment' on the whole subject."
